Definition: properly, to puncture, i.e. (figuratively through the idea of slipping out) to escape or survive
BiblicalUsage: Sarad is slipping away, escaping when the rest are cut down. After Joshua's great slaughter, the rest that remained of the Amorites slipped into their fenced cities.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that escaping judgment is not the same as being delivered from it, and a fenced city is no refuge from God.
